summary: Cherokee County TX lookout at Rusk: a June 1939 item calls it Tower No. 9, patrolman-staffed in 1946, named in a January 1993 Texas Forest Service sale notice. The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists Rusk Loc 1 and Loc 2 as gone; no source ties the 1939-1946 reports to either site.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association lists Rusk (Loc 1) and Rusk (Loc 2) as Tower Gone; the only related record found is a 1993 notice inviting bids for sale, dismantling and removal of Texas Forest Service lookout towers, which names a Rusk tower with no site number

events.note: June 2, 1939 item calls it Tower No. 9, 1 1/2 miles northwest of Rusk; no build date in any source read
Forest Patrolman J. Layton Jones handled fires at the Rusk lookout tower in January and March 1946 per newspaper reports reprinted on the Forest Lookouts page; reports do not confirm which Rusk tower

Notice dated January 15, 1993 invites sealed bids for sale, dismantling and removal of Texas Forest Service fire lookout towers, including Rusk Fire Lookout Tower, Cherokee County; the outcome is not recorded in sources read

notes_for_editor: Identity is the main problem. FFLA lists two Rusk towers, Loc 1 (31.81696, -95.16485) and Loc 2 (31.80444, -95.11667). The Forest Lookouts page has one Rusk tower with no location, so its 1939 and 1946 reports cannot be tied to Loc 2 from the sources. My own geometry, not a source: the 1939 placement 'northwest of Rusk' fits Loc 1 better, since Loc 2 is east of town; Mapcarta says Rusk is 2 miles west of its Rusk Lookout Tower, which sits at Loc 2 coordinates. The Mapcarta entry is a map label with no description of structure, so the story says only that. Not checked: NRHP or FFLOS entries (none linked on the record). A Texas Forest Service fire-protection archive item was seen only in search results and was not reachable, so nothing from it is used. Budget used: 2 WebSearch, 5 fetch_text page reads.
